capabilities: bind attachment folder names to note names
automatically rename pasted image files and attachment folders
download a note's remote images into its attachment folder
extras: The plugin overwrites the 'New link format' and 'Default location for new attachments' core settings and restores them when disabled; it supports md and canvas notes.
problem: Obsidian's built-in attachment settings use one fixed folder location, so attachments don't follow note names when notes are renamed or deleted.
summary: Attachment manager that binds an attachment folder to each note's name, auto-renaming, deleting and hiding folders and files as notes change.
